Quote any rate ratio off this fixture to the year, never the day.

pairings.label: Planck — the quantum of action
pairings.reference: Planck, 'Zur Theorie des Gesetzes der Energieverteilung im Normalspectrum', Verh. Dtsch. Phys. Ges. 2 (1900) 237
pairings.reference_locator: presented to the German Physical Society, 14 Dec 1900
pairings.note: The 19 Oct 1900 talk gave the empirical radiation law; h enters at the 14 Dec derivation. The fixture's label names the quantum of action, so December is the correct event.

pairings.label: Einstein — the light quantum
pairings.reference: Einstein, 'Ueber einen die Erzeugung und Verwandlung des Lichtes betreffenden heuristischen Gesichtspunkt', Annalen der Physik 17 (1905) 132-148
pairings.reference_locator: received by Annalen der Physik 18 Mar 1905

pairings.label: Bohr — quantised atomic structure
pairings.reference: Bohr, 'On the Constitution of Atoms and Molecules, Part I', Philosophical Magazine 26 (1913) 1-25
pairings.reference_locator: Philosophical Magazine, July 1913 (Parts II and III Sept and Nov 1913)
pairings.note: Month is right; the 1st is filler. No day established in the sources checked.

pairings.label: Compton — the quantum carries momentum
pairings.reference: Compton, 'A Quantum Theory of the Scattering of X-rays by Light Elements', Physical Review 21 (1923) 483-502
pairings.reference_locator: read at the APS meeting, Chicago, 1-2 Dec 1922; submitted to Physical Review 13 Dec 1922; published May 1923
pairings.note: Three candidate dates exist. The fixture chooses announcement; that is a third convention again and should be stated rather than assumed.

pairings.label: de Broglie — matter waves
pairings.reference: de Broglie, 'Recherches sur la theorie des quanta', doctoral thesis, Paris (1924)
pairings.reference_locator: defended 25 Nov 1924; published in Annales de Physique early 1925

pairings.label: Pauli — the exclusion principle
pairings.reference: Pauli, 'Ueber den Zusammenhang des Abschlusses der Elektronengruppen im Atom mit der Komplexstruktur der Spektren', Zeitschrift fuer Physik 31 (1925) 765-783
pairings.note: Does NOT blur exclusion with spin: the Resource says 'a fourth two-valued quantum number', which is Pauli's own formulation. Spin is Uhlenbeck and Goudsmit, Naturwissenschaften, letter dated 17 Oct 1925 - different people, different result, correctly absent.

pairings.label: Heisenberg — matrix mechanics
pairings.reference: Heisenberg, 'Ueber quantentheoretische Umdeutung kinematischer und mechanischer Beziehungen', Zeitschrift fuer Physik 33 (1925) 879-893

pairings.label: Schroedinger — the wave equation
pairings.reference: Schroedinger, 'Quantisierung als Eigenwertproblem' (First Communication), Annalen der Physik 384 (1926) 361-376

pairings.label: Dirac — unification and the relativistic electron
pairings.reference: Dirac, 'The Quantum Theory of the Electron', Proc. R. Soc. A 117 (1928) 610-624; AND Dirac, 'The Principles of Quantum Mechanics', Clarendon Press (1930)
pairings.reference_locator: relativistic equation submitted 2 Jan 1928, published 1 Feb 1928; transformation theory 1927; Principles published summer 1930, no day sourced
pairings.note: PRIMARY DEFECT. The row is dated and sourced to the 1930 textbook, but its Solution claims spin, the magnetic moment and antimatter - consequences of the Jan 1928 equation. The carried day 1930-05-29 is unverifiable. Split into two rows or pick one.

pairings.label: von Neumann — the mathematical foundation
pairings.reference: von Neumann, 'Mathematische Grundlagen der Quantenmechanik', Springer (1932)
pairings.note: Jan 1 is an absence dressed as a measurement.
